organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: We do not have a building - we have a route and 9 regular stops. Cold hold is the van's, sized for one route, not for stock. Collection suits us better than delivery; we are rarely at base.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 45% of residents below the poverty line, 52% of households without a vehicle, 38% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Shakespear Rose Community Table Incorporated team,

A grocer in Chicago has ten crates of spinach. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 6 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 2 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
